title: Show stress test scenario panel for Bayview call
author: israelpollak-hub
body:
Request from Joe Smith: he wants the +100 / -100 basis points results visible on the dashboard during the Bayview client call with Rachel Stein.

Scope for v0.4: table of scenarios, loss versus limit bar, duration and convexity next to it.
Owner: Priya Natarajan. Data from Daniel Okafor's engine; curve chart from Maria Delgado.
